title: Compilation may produce target-specific machine representations
proposition: A compiler code-generation stage may translate an intermediate representation into target-specific assembly or binary machine code.
scope: LLVM's code-generation architecture as an example, not a universal requirement for all language implementations.
exceptions: Interpreters and hybrid JIT systems may use different pipelines.
score_rationale: LLVM official documentation directly defines this bounded translation path; low independence is offset by narrow implementation-specific wording.
